Q: Need to display plaintext passwords to teacher for 2nd grader accounts A:

[To meet security/privacy AND legal requirements in most countries] Instead of allowing the teacher to know the pw, including the moment when he/she re-sets the pw: (1) amend the system so that for authorized cases, the student's data can be accessed by either the student credentials (login + password) ; or by his/her teacher's login credentials (login + password) + student ID -- in case the student cannot remember the password. (2) for point 1 to be effective, ask the students' parents to sign an authorization letter saying that in case the student cannot remember the password then the teacher can "act on behalf of the student" to login the system, but in that case a new password re-set link will be sent to the parent so that the parent get alerted, can later reset the password and tell the student the new password.

Q: How to update libstdc++.so.6 or change the file to use on Tensorflow, Python A:

I had this same issue and setting the LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the /lib directory of the conda environment fixed the problem for me:

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/app/anaconda3/lib

Q: windows and anonymous authentication on IIS 7.5, allow auto login for internal and manual login for external A:

This is how to configure IIS for integrated authentication.

http://netpl.blogspot.com/2012/06/iis-75-integrated-security-with-no.html

This will make your site available for intranet users WITHOUT the prompt for credentials.

Note that this also works for web users. A built-in web browser window is displayed as a result of HTTP 401. A user provides his/her credentials and is in.

If you rather want to show your custom web form as a result of 401 (unauthorized), you'd have to trick the browser a little:

http://www.codeproject.com/Articles/11202/Redirecting-to-custom-401-page-when-quot-Access-de

This way you can redirect an unauthorized response to a web form of your choice (for example, to show an asp.net login form).

Although the integrated authentication can be easily configured, prepare for a lot of experiments when setting up your mixed (integrated/forms) authentication. Things change with every version of IIS; also IIS7 behaves differently if a pool is in classic vs integrated mode.
